standard_prerequisites.name: The natural functor from the derived category of coherent modules to the derived category of quasi-coherent modules is fully faithful, and its essential image consists of the objects whose cohomology sheaves are coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies full faithfulness of the left vertical arrow and detects when an object of D^-(QCoh) comes from D^-(Coh).

standard_prerequisites.name: On a Noetherian scheme the derived category of quasi-coherent modules identifies with the derived category of all modules, preserving coherent cohomology sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports an object K of D^-_Coh to an object K' of D^-(QCoh) with the same cohomology sheaves.

core_obligations: Set up the commutative square with corners D^-(Coh), D^-_Coh, D^-(QCoh), D^-_QCoh and horizontal functors the inclusions into the derived category with quasi-coherent cohomology (proof lines 2827-2830).

Fully faithfulness of the top arrow: the left vertical arrow is fully faithful by Lemma coh-to-qcoh, the bottom arrow is an equivalence by Proposition Noetherian, and the right vertical arrow is fully faithful by construction; the square then forces the top horizontal arrow to be fully faithful (proof lines 2830-2835).

Essential surjectivity: given K in D^-_Coh, let K' be the corresponding object of D^-(QCoh) from Proposition Noetherian; its cohomology sheaves are the cohomology sheaves of K, hence coherent, so K' lies in the essential image of the left vertical arrow by Lemma coh-to-qcoh, and the top arrow is essentially surjective (proof lines 2835-2846).
The bounded case D^b(Coh) to D^b_Coh follows immediately from the bounded above case by truncation (proof lines 2846-2849).
proof_roadmap: Draw the square of four functors (proof lines 2827-2830).
Deduce full faithfulness of the top arrow from the other three sides (proof lines 2830-2835).
Get essential surjectivity from the Noetherian correspondence and the coherent-cohomology detection (proof lines 2835-2846).
Pass to the bounded case by truncation (proof lines 2846-2849).
